## Summary

Describe the change and any effect on scientific semantics.

## Verification

- [ ] `python scripts/check_publication_hygiene.py`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] Documentation and tests reflect user-visible changes
- [ ] No research data, checkpoints, logs, private paths, invented metrics, or
      unreviewed result claims are included

## Provenance

For scientific changes, identify the configuration and real-data validation
needed before the change can support a result claim.
